The '''Polmanar system''' was located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Polmanar/Legends|Polmanar]].
